description: Base wallet balance for any address: ETH, USDC and about 25 widely held Base tokens, plus up to 20 ERC-20 token contracts you name, each with symbol, decimals, raw and formatted amount and the block number read, live from Base mainnet RPC. Required: address. $0.002 USDC on Base. Failed read, no charge. No account, no API key. Base mainnet only; no prices or USD values; tokens outside the list and your extras are not discovered. By Ontario Protocol. [PAID: 0.002 USDC via x402 on Base. Two-step flow: a call without payment returns MCP PaymentRequired; the retry carries the signed PaymentPayload in params._meta['x402/payment']. The legacy _x402_payment base64 argument is also supported. Signing happens in the caller's wallet.]

_x402_payment.description: base64 x402 PaymentPayload (USDC on Base); obtain the requirements by calling this tool without it first.

address.description: Base wallet or contract address to read.

tokens.description: Optional comma-separated ERC-20 contract addresses to read as well, max 20.

name: ontario_base-balances
title: Base Wallet Balances

x402.not_for: Not a price or USD valuation, not other chains, and not a discovery of every token the wallet holds.
x402.purchase_reason: Current Base holdings for a wallet with exact raw and formatted amounts, without running an RPC client.
x402.selection_rule: Returns live Base balances for one address: ETH, nonzero default-list tokens and every requested ERC-20, read in one Multicall3 call at a stated block. The read runs before settlement; a failed read is not charged.
